escena: SCENE (a large partner technology conference in Boston, breakout session hall, evening): a single hard stage spot from high front-right rakes ONTO THE MAN, splitting his face into bright and shadow and leaving the room behind him dark; he stands turned three-quarters towards the screen, arm extended and finger pointing up at one node of the diagram at the exact moment he names it, mouth open mid-word. He is wearing a faded olive linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow; no jacket, no blazer, no navy or blue clothing. He looks at the screen, never at the camera. The screen behind him glows cool azure blue with a simple abstract diagram of connected nodes, softly out of focus and completely unbranded, with no readable text, no letters and no logos anywhere. An orange gaffer-tape mark on the stage floor catches the light near his feet. 35mm lens at f/2.8 from the front row looking slightly up.

lecho.objeto: the matte black top edge of a stage monitor wedge standing between the camera and the stage
lecho.tono: DARK near black, matte, with subtle texture
